title: Cavity temp sensor open
shortDescription: Cavity RTD probe reading open circuit.
fullDescription: The Combitherm detected an open circuit on the oven cavity sensor. Cooking will not start until the sensor is repaired or replaced.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Switch off at the wall for 60 seconds.

fixSteps.title: Replace RTD
fixSteps.instruction: Technician replaces cavity probe and tests resistance.

whenToCallPro: Sensor replacement requires panel removal; call a tech.

faq.a: Without a valid cavity temp the controller refuses to fire heaters for safety.

title: Cavity sensor shorted
shortDescription: Cavity RTD reading shorted to ground.
fullDescription: Sensor wires shorted or RTD failed to a low-impedance state. Cooking is locked. Replacement of probe usually required.

fixSteps.title: Inspect
fixSteps.instruction: Tech inspects harness for damage near steam exhaust.

fixSteps.title: Replace
fixSteps.instruction: Replace probe and reroute harness if needed.

faq.a: Yes, both faults indicate the same sensor.

title: Core probe error
shortDescription: Food probe out of valid range.
fullDescription: The detachable core temperature probe is open or shorted. Probe-driven cook modes are blocked but timed cooking still works.

fixSteps.title: Inspect cable
fixSteps.instruction: Look for cuts, kinks, melted spots.

fixSteps.title: Replace probe
fixSteps.instruction: Plug new core probe into socket.

whenToCallPro: Only if internal connector is damaged.

faq.a: Yes, but only with time-based programs.

title: Boiler fill timeout
shortDescription: Steam boiler did not fill within allowed time.
fullDescription: On boilered Combitherm models, the system did not detect water reaching probe within the timeout. Water supply or fill valve issue.

fixSteps.title: Check supply
fixSteps.instruction: Open shutoff valve and verify pressure.

fixSteps.title: Replace solenoid
fixSteps.instruction: Tech replaces fill valve if coil failed.

whenToCallPro: If supply confirmed and strainer clean.

title: Boiler drain fault
fullDescription: Boiler failed to empty during scheduled drain. Usually caused by drain valve blockage or scale.

fixSteps.title: Service valve
fixSteps.instruction: Tech disassembles drain valve, clears or replaces.

title: Cavity over-temperature
fullDescription: Cavity temp went above safety setpoint. Hi-limit may have tripped. Often a stuck contactor or runaway sensor.

fixSteps.title: Cool unit
fixSteps.instruction: Power off and let cool 30 minutes.

faq.a: No, do not run until tech clears the fault.

title: Blower motor fault
fullDescription: VFD or motor reported a fault. Cooking pauses to protect motor. Common after scale spray-down hits motor.

fixSteps.title: Cool
fixSteps.instruction: Allow motor to cool 30 minutes after power off.

fixSteps.title: Service
fixSteps.instruction: Tech tests VFD and motor windings.

faq.a: Keep door fully closed during cleaning to protect motor.

title: Door switch fault
shortDescription: Door switch state inconsistent during cycle.
fullDescription: Cabinet detected door open during cooking or vice versa. Reed switch or magnet alignment issue.

fixSteps.title: Latch firmly
fixSteps.instruction: Push door closed and confirm handle clicks.

faq.a: If steam leaks at the gasket, replace seal.

title: Combiclean pump fault
shortDescription: Wash pump not delivering required flow.
fullDescription: Cleaning cycle aborted due to low pump flow. Check sump filter and detergent dosing pump.

fixSteps.title: Clean sump
fixSteps.instruction: Remove sump filter and clear food debris.

fixSteps.title: Replace pump
fixSteps.instruction: Tech replaces pump if motor fails.

title: Communication error
shortDescription: Display lost contact with control board.
fullDescription: Internal communication bus failure. Often caused by loose ribbon cable or failed control PCB.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Hard reset at breaker for 60 seconds.

fixSteps.title: Inspect cables
fixSteps.instruction: Tech reseats ribbon cable between display and control.

faq.a: Yes, dedicated commercial surge protection prevents board failure.
